primary.analytical_question: For the hypothetical financial-services chart-agent proposal, distinguish readiness to plan, execute isolated public/synthetic learning, and operate next-quarter routine service under the primary organizational evidence profile without importing capabilities from another packet.
primary.general_et_finding: Agentic AI combines model-selected tool actions, observations, scoped permissions and a human stop path; it creates organizational duties beyond ordinary BI charting: competent source checking, error escalation, access control, audit lineage, change management, monitoring, fallback and continuous service coverage. Its technology maturity cannot be inferred from this organization’s permission, staff or budget. C1 and C3 frame adoption as separate technology, task and organizational questions; S1/S2 offer voluntary role and lifecycle guidance, not proof of implementation.
primary.application_finding: For human-supervised chart review, an analyst would submit a public or synthetic chart and its source table; read-only agent tools would draft source-linked discrepancy notes, which a qualified human accepts or rejects before any publication. Correct denominators, label interpretation, context and uncertainty matter; exceptions and ambiguous graphics require abstention/escalation. Task/technology fit and reproducible technical performance remain UNVALIDATED and comparative net advantage versus manual and deterministic review UNKNOWN in all four packets. Neither an approval nor a training dry run establishes accuracy, reduced total review burden or safe routine use.
primary.organization_specific_finding:
CASE primary | Eight-domain case-evidence profile; SUPPORTED always limited to explicitly stated scope, PARTIAL is qualified and UNKNOWN is not failure:
Leadership/sponsorship — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No sponsor charter, trial authority or residual-risk decision owner supplied. Consequence: No accountable decision or permission to execute. Closure: Proposed reporting executive provides signed charter, scoped decision rights, risk acceptance and trial permission.
Skills/training — PARTIAL: Evidence: Experienced BI analysts; no agent source-trace, denominator, hallucination or escalation competency results. Consequence: Reviewers may approve unsupported drafts. Closure: Proposed analytics manager records ordinary-user and deputy practical competency/repair checks.
Workflow/process — PARTIAL: Evidence: Human publication sign-off is required; correction/exception handoff and full-review effort are undocumented. Consequence: Escaped drafts or hidden checking cost. Closure: Proposed reporting owner dry-runs exception queue, sign-off, end-to-end timings and manual fallback.
Infrastructure/data — GAP: Evidence: No approved agent model/trial environment; internal/production access explicitly not approved. Consequence: Agent execution would exceed permission and risk uncontrolled data access. Closure: Proposed security/model-risk authority signs sandbox/model/tool/data boundary, read-only rights, isolation and trace logs.
Resources/budget — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No protected POC reviewer/support hours, cap or recurring allocation. Consequence: Unstaffed review and unaffordable service continuity. Closure: Proposed finance owner confirms scoped POC cap and separately approved next-quarter amount, period, coverage and contingency.
Governance/risk — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No designated escalation, incident/change authority or exercised stop/restore. Consequence: Material errors could persist without safe recovery. Closure: Proposed risk owner signs incident/stop/change controls and witnesses rollback drill.
Culture/change — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No representative ordinary-user acceptance or safe reporting evidence; no resistance established. Consequence: Workload may be rejected or errors concealed. Closure: Proposed analytics lead collects recorded participation, workload feedback and dissent channel.
Operating ownership — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No accepted service owner/deputy, maintenance, monitoring or retirement duty. Consequence: Orphaned tool and coverage failure. Closure: Proposed reporting leader obtains written duty/cover, monitoring, support, change and retirement assignment.
Scope conclusions: PLAN: READY_TO_PLAN using desk research, manual and deterministic baselines only. ISOLATED POC: NOT_READY_FOR_EXECUTION: explicit lack of trial/model-route approval and unknown protected competent reviewers, owner, stop and funding. ROUTINE: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_FOR_SUSTAINED_USE and no authorization; technical fit, value, ongoing capacity and release unproved.

primary.confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that no agent execution authorization is supplied and that no routine readiness is established; low confidence about unreported sponsor, culture, training or finances, explicitly UNKNOWN rather than absent. Case dated 2026-11-04; general NIST editions 2023-01/2024-07 reviewed 2026-11-04. Fictional, not audited.
primary.value_opportunity_implication: Potentially fewer chart-claim checking hours with stronger traceability, but the net benefit is UNKNOWN until comparative representative testing includes false/missed corrections, human correction, maintenance and support time. Conventional manual plus deterministic checks remain the baseline. Organizational readiness does not prove utility or authorize an adoption posture change.
primary.risk_governance_implication: Main consequences are wrong denominators, invented links, privacy/access breach, misleading reports and inappropriate executive reliance. Restrict to reversible source-linked drafts, independently human-authorized publication, least privilege, full logs, escalation, incident stops, reviewer coverage and manual recovery. The risk owner must set materiality/tolerances; do not mistake a dry run for technical validation or assert legal compliance.
primary.recommendation_management_implication:
Binding gap is absence of scoped trial authority and approved model/data route, coupled with unassigned accountable execution and protected competent review; BI experience cannot offset these gates. P1 proposed reporting sponsor + security/model-risk authority, before any execution: sign a public/synthetic-only charter, authorize exact model/tools and read-only route, establish residual-risk and stop authority; closure signed permission plus sandbox/log check; blocks POC. P2 proposed reporting service owner + finance/analytics heads: accept owner/deputy duties and obtain protected ordinary-reviewer/support hours and explicit POC cap; separately inquire about next-quarter funding; closure signed rota, competency roster and finance authorizations; blocks POC and service. P3 proposed analytics/risk leads: assess actual source checking, exceptions, publication signoff, incident/restore and feedback; closure recorded exercises, ordinary-user acceptance and agreed tolerance sheet; blocks credible POC. Four weeks is a review plan, not a promise of approval.
CONDITIONAL DESIGN, not an executed study: across four weeks use analyst-submitted public/synthetic charts and source tables, read-only agent-generated source-linked notes, a qualified reviewer deciding accept/reject, and human-only publication. This case is PLANNING ONLY until separate authorized owners document and satisfy all permissions, staffing, competent reviewer/backup, approved route, stop/recovery, cap and acceptance criteria; permission alone is not enough. No POC budget or protected-hour cap is supplied in this case: secure explicit capacity/approval first; no 24-hour cap is imported. Agree task breadth, materiality/error tolerance and success criteria BEFORE execution; use normal, ambiguous and adversarial/incorrect-denominator samples plus absent-reviewer and incident/restore drills. Capture reproducible source traces, missed/false corrections, abstentions, unsupported claims, total setup/review/correction/support labor, reviewer feedback, cover and restore outcomes; compare manual/deterministic best baseline, not just model output. Stop and revert to manual review for forbidden access, publication escape, missing lineage/oversight, cap exhaustion, absent qualified coverage or material unsupported claims. Review in week four or earlier on incidents or changes to staff/model/data terms. Separate feasibility, incremental value and sustainable governance exit decisions; zero errors on a small set cannot certify production.
change_monitoring_triggers: Four-week review of actual control, trace, accuracy, effort and acceptance records, if an authorized study occurs; otherwise review documented readiness progress only.
Immediate reassessment after incident, lost lineage, forbidden access, changed model/tool/data terms, lost sponsor/reviewer/deputy or cap exhaustion.

Before any routine proposal, reassess next-quarter owner/cover, recurring signed budget, performance/value versus best baseline and separately granted risk/operating approval; quarterly thereafter if released.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: EXPLICIT CONDITION: No affirmative assurance of routine use until representative task performance/net value, authorized production route and risk release, funded covered owner/deputy and continued monitoring are evidenced; do not run a real trial based on this analysis.

missing_budget.analytical_question: For the hypothetical financial-services chart-agent proposal, distinguish readiness to plan, execute isolated public/synthetic learning, and operate next-quarter routine service under the missing_budget organizational evidence profile without importing capabilities from another packet.
missing_budget.general_et_finding: Agentic AI combines model-selected tool actions, observations, scoped permissions and a human stop path; it creates organizational duties beyond ordinary BI charting: competent source checking, error escalation, access control, audit lineage, change management, monitoring, fallback and continuous service coverage. Its technology maturity cannot be inferred from this organization’s permission, staff or budget. C1 and C3 frame adoption as separate technology, task and organizational questions; S1/S2 offer voluntary role and lifecycle guidance, not proof of implementation.
missing_budget.application_finding: For human-supervised chart review, an analyst would submit a public or synthetic chart and its source table; read-only agent tools would draft source-linked discrepancy notes, which a qualified human accepts or rejects before any publication. Correct denominators, label interpretation, context and uncertainty matter; exceptions and ambiguous graphics require abstention/escalation. Task/technology fit and reproducible technical performance remain UNVALIDATED and comparative net advantage versus manual and deterministic review UNKNOWN in all four packets. Neither an approval nor a training dry run establishes accuracy, reduced total review burden or safe routine use.
